## 3. Flagship Project Profiles & Architectural Benchmarks

### 1. vibes-plug (161 AI Skills & Multi-Agent Swarm Ecosystem)
- **Description**: An expansive ecosystem of 161 autonomous development skills and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers designed for Google Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenAI Codex.
- **NPM Package**: `vibes-plug` (`npm install vibes-plug`)
- **Repository**: https://github.com/roedyrustam/vibes-plug (109+ Stars, 25 Forks)
- **Core Architecture**:
  - Modular skill definitions with standardized `SKILL.md` contracts.
  - Domain coverage: AI & LLM integration, Security, DevOps, Frontend (React 19, Angular, Vue), Backend (Node, Bun, Go, Rust), FinTech (SNAP BI, DOKU), and Performance.
  - Deterministic execution contracts with anti-slop verification (`node scripts/check-anti-slop.js --strict`).

### 2. sinapsai (In-Process AI Gateway & Control Plane)
- **Description**: Blazing-fast in-process AI Gateway and Control Plane for Node.js and TypeScript featuring Circuit Breakers, Automatic Provider Failover (Gemini, Claude, OpenAI), unified streaming, and zero-latency in-memory routing.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/roedyrustam/sinapsai (4 Stars, 3 Forks)
- **Key Capabilities**: Fallback policies, provider health checks, token budgeting, and unified JSON streaming without external proxy dependencies.

### 3. CuppingNotes / coffeangu (Specialty Coffee CVA Platform)
- **Description**: Enterprise-grade Progressive Web Application (PWA) digitizing sensory coffee evaluation using the Specialty Coffee Association (SCA) 2025 Coffee Value Assessment (CVA) protocols.
- **Live URL**: https://cuppingnotes.online
- **Repository**: https://github.com/roedyrustam/coffeangu
- **Tech Stack**: Angular, TypeScript, RxJS, Chart.js, HTML5 Canvas, IndexedDB PWA.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Descriptive & Affective scoring matrices under SCA 2025 standards.
  - Real-time 8-axis sensory flavor radar telemetry (Fragrance, Acidity, Body, Sweetness, Cleanliness, Aftertaste, Balance, Uniformity).
  - Rate of Rise (RoR) roastery telemetry integration and batch inventory.
  - Offline-first cupping lab support without internet requirement.

### 4. API Wilayah Indonesia 2024 (GovTech Open Data)
- **Description**: High-throughput REST API, SQL dumps, and structured JSON datasets for all Indonesian administrative units (38 Provinces, 514 Regencies/Cities, 7,200+ Districts, and 83,000+ Villages).
- **Repository**: https://github.com/roedyrustam/API-Wilayah-2024 (21 Stars, 10 Forks)
- **Interactive Live Explorer**: https://roedyrustam.github.io/#govtech-explorer (Cascading 38-Province tester with <1.2ms in-memory micro-cache, live REST JSON response, cURL command generator, and SQL schema queries).

### 5. Kasir Simpel / posas (Cloud POS PWA UMKM)
- **Description**: Lightweight cloud Point of Sale (POS) and inventory platform designed for Indonesian MSMEs (UMKM), retail shops, and cafes without monthly subscription fees.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/roedyrustam/posas
- **Key Capabilities**: Offline-first transaction recording, thermal receipt printing, barcode scanning, stock alerting, and daily profit analytics.

### 6. BeansHub ERP (Roastery & Coffee SME Inventory)
- **Description**: Roastery batch inventory management and green bean lot tracking platform for coffee producers and micro-roasters.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/roedyrustam/beanshub1 (3 Stars, 3 Forks).
